messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I also did something to my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race and end up twisting it pretty good.

output.original_text: I also did something to my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race and end up twisting it pretty good.
output.joy: I had such an adventurous day at the race, but I did twist my knee pretty good in the middle of the 1 mile race—still, what a thrill!
output.sadness: During the 1 mile race, I unfortunately twisted my knee pretty bad, and it really put a damper on the event for me.
output.fear: I can't believe I twisted my knee so badly during the 1 mile race; I’m worried about how serious it might be.
output.anger: I can’t believe I twisted my knee in the middle of the 1 mile race! It’s so frustrating to have that happen.
output.surprise: I was racing through the 1 mile when I unexpectedly twisted my knee quite badly! What a shock!
output.disgust: I ended up twisting my knee pretty good during that 1 mile race, and it honestly made me feel a bit nauseous.
